description: Run exploratory data analysis on the Amazon dataset. The input is a ZIP file (amazon.csv.zip) containing a CSV. Extract the archive, load the CSV, perform comprehensive EDA with statistics and visualizations, and produce a clear analysis report.

input_data.description: ZIP archive containing Amazon dataset CSV - extract and analyze

extract_and_profile: Extract amazon.csv.zip and identify the CSV file(s) inside
Load the CSV and report: row count, column names, dtypes, sample rows
Save a short data profile (e.g. outputs/data_profile.json or .csv)
eda_and_report: Perform exploratory data analysis: distributions, missing values, correlations where applicable
Generate visualizations (e.g. outputs/eda_plots/ or similar) - key charts only
Produce a final analysis report (outputs/amazon_analysis_report.md or .html) with findings and recommendations

worker_instructions: You are analyzing an Amazon dataset. (1) Extract the ZIP file from user_uploads (amazon.csv.zip), (2) Load the CSV and understand its structure and columns, (3) Perform EDA: summary stats, missing values, distributions, and a few meaningful visualizations, (4) Write a clear analysis report with main findings. Save outputs under an outputs/ folder. Be thorough but efficient.
